patch_description: After the main seed loop and hill-climb, add a perturb-and-reanneal phase around the incumbent best: perturb best_pts by Gaussian noise, then run a full L-BFGS-B annealing chain (soft-min on sphere followed by the free-space soft-min/soft-max objective) on each perturbed start, keeping strict improvements. This is the highest-value compute identified: re-optimizing the incumbent with fresh annealing chains lets the configuration escape shallow local optima that greedy hill-climbing alone cannot, while the annealing schedule smooths the objective enough to find better basins. Each restart is cheap (~0.3s) so 8 restarts fit comfortably in the timeout.
